title: run_capped timeout bounds only the read loop; child closing stdout/stderr while running wedges the turn
notes: Imported by S-080 (D-015-04 amended) from the 2026-09-29 re-check: verdict fixed in db5b8c34 (shipped in v1.0.0-rc.10).
